title: 5th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/2/2026).

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Health, Family and Welfare Aqeela Ali: where has it been decided to build the mental health hospital, why must it be a separate facility, and if a study was done on the pros and cons of siting it outside Malé, what are its details?

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Health, Family and Welfare Aqeela Ali: with cancer cases rising, the government decided to build a dedicated cancer hospital; what is the current status, when will work start, and when will services begin?
First reading of the bill to amend the Act on becoming a resident of an island in the Maldives (Law No. 46/78), submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Preliminary debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nomination of a member to the Elections Commission, under Article 4(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the health minister on mental health and cancer hospitals, introduced a bill on island residency, opened debate on the Digital Identity Bill, continued the Maldives 2.0 bill debate, and took a committee report on an Elections Commission member nominee.
